messages:
Sam: Heads-up — prepping release v2.14.0 now. We're going to use a tempo-slowdown ramp for feature flag `fast-embed` during the cutover. Quiet window is 23:00-02:00 UTC.
Jordan: +1. What's the ramp plan?
Sam: Ramp: 0% -> 5% (10m soak) -> 25% (30m soak) -> 60% (30m soak) -> 100% (gradual over 1h). If telemetry is green at each soak we continue.
Lee: Can we add hard rollback triggers? Last time a p99 spike slipped through.
Ana: Yea — let's make triggers: error rate increase > 0.5% vs baseline OR p99 latency up by >200ms OR model output quality drop on prompt test set (we've got eval hooks).
Sam: Agreed. Also pin model version to `embed-v3.2` in routing during the rollout so traffic doesn't flip to newer variants.
Jordan: I'll update the release notes snippet: "Enable fast-embed FF (opt-in gradual ramp). Pin embed-v3.2 for consistency. QA; monitor eval set and rollout telemetry"
Praveen: I added a quick checklist in the PR comment with the commands. QA will run the smoke prompt set at each soak. @Ana you'll get a reminder.
Ana: Got it. I'll start smoke runs once deploy-bot marks canary complete.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary deployment succeeded for service=embed-service, commit=5f3b9a2.
Sam: Ok starting 5% gate now. Command if needed: `ffctl set fast-embed --percent 5 --reason "v2.14 canary"`
Lee: Observability note — set the canary-tag `release:v2.14` so metrics slice cleanly.
Sam: Done. `curl -X POST https://metrics.internal/slice -d 'tag=release:v2.14'` (internal only).
Jordan: Release notes draft posted: https://redwood-internal/docs/releases/v2.14 — please add any UX caveats.
Ana: After 5m smoke: no errors on smoke prompts, p99 +12ms (within noise). Proceed to 25%. :thumbsup:
Sam: Moving to 25% now. `ffctl set fast-embed --percent 25`
Praveen: Telemetry watch: setting alert window 5m for p50/p95/p99 and error-rate diff.
deploy-bot: [ff] fast-embed set to 25% by Sam
Lee: At 20m into 25% soak, p99 steady, error-rate +0.1%. Passing.
Ana: QA run passed on eval set (precision unchanged). Ready for 60% ramp in 10m.
Sam: Scheduling 60% ramp — we'll pause if the first 10m shows any regressions.
Jordan: Also adding note in release notes: "rollback triggers: >0.5% error, p99 +200ms, eval drift"
Sam: If we need urgent rollback command: `ffctl set fast-embed --percent 0 --note "rollback v2.14"` — ops runbook updated.
Praveen: In the unlikely event of a partial rollback we should drain cohorts before full disable. Use `cohortctl drain --cohort release:v2.14` to reduce client surprise.
Lee: Reminder — during quiet window we keep pager policies at normal sensitivity. Oncall, please stay alert for first 2h after 100% traffic.
Ana: I'll finalize QA signoff and paste results in the PR.
Sam: If all good we'll finish cutover at 01:15 UTC and tag the release. Thanks folks.
Praveen: :thumbsup: will monitor and can flip to rollback if any trigger hits.
deploy-bot: [release] v2.14.0 successfully tagged (tag=v2.14.0, owner=Sam)
